quest_lastdenn_ryiah.name: Ryiah
quest_lastdenn_ryiah.comment: WARNING: phraseId 20 is used in a conv condition.

text: Psst. You there, with the face that says "bad ideas welcome".
They threw me in this cell because they think I'm a witch.
And true, I am a witch. But that's not the point.
Witches don't belong in jail. They belong outside jails, where they can be free to do witchy things.
If you'll help me achieve that, perhaps I can use those witchy things to help you out in return.

choices.text: *Ask what she needs.*
*No illegal prison break for you. Take your leave.*

text: A guard is off duty somewhere in the bar.
How do I know that? Because I'm a witch! I know things.
He has my jail key. And you need to get it from him.
He is probably drunk, so this shouldn't be too difficult, but also not easy.
Don't forget, my freedom is on the line here. Good luck!
You're back?
Do you have the jail key? Are you serious? What are you waiting for?
*Hic*
Hn. If it's the barkeep you want, he's the one behind the bar. If it's me - *Hic* I'm off duty. Way... way off duty.

choices.text: *Tell him you're here for the key of Ryiah's jail cell.*
*Let him be with his drink. Take your leave.*

text: ...The witch's cell key? I can't give you that... Why should you give me that? I mean... Why should I give you that?

choices.text: [Barbarian 1] *Warn him a witch remembers the man who caged her.*
[Diplomat 1] *Argue Ryiah has done nothing wrong.*
[Jester 1] *Joke that no sane man guards a witch for the mayor's wage.*
*Remind him you could just take it off a drunk.*
*Press a coin in his palm.*
*Leave him to his bottle.*

text: Hah! I may be drunk, but I'm not shtupid. *Hic* Try it. One scream and my collea... colla... the whole watch comes running - that what you want?
Gold? You think drunk and cheap are the shame... the same? Put it away.
I've been threatened before with fists and blades. A curse is a new one, *Hic* I'll grant you that.
But threats are part of the job. I can't let a wi... witch go free.
Done nothing wrong. That's what they all shay, all the time. I never set anyone free on say-so.
The mayor fills those cells and the mayor empties them. Take your case to the major - *Hic* the mayor, if you've the shtomach for him.
Hah! No sane man! I sh... sh... should ask for a *Hic* raise!
Higher raise, more sanity. That's jusht how the maths works. But wage or no wage, mayor or no... m... mayor, the key shtays on my belt.

choices.text: [Diplomat 1] *Press him: the arrest was never just, and he knows it.*
[Jester 1] *Quip the mayor would charge admission to her cell.*
*Grab a fistful of his collar.*
*Threaten to report a guard drunk with the cell keys.*
*Leave him to his bottle.*

text: Careful now. Shake me any harder and you'll be wearing my ale.
Report it - a guard drunk with the keys on his belt? Aye, a breeeach. But that doesn't get you the key from me.
...You may be *Hic* right, but it's not my... c... call.
...Is it? The mayor will have my... my hide if I let her go.
Hah! ...Aye, he would and all, the greasy little toad. A copper a gawk, and the coin shtraight... in his purse.
You funny g... guy. *Hic* ...Why am I even guarding her for that toad?

text: As a guard, I can ha... handle angry men. You go away now.
Prisoners also sometimes beg. I've been trained *Hic* not to give in to beggars.

You know what? Here's the *Hic* key. Let the both of us have the last l... laugh on the mayor for once.

Prisoners also sometimes beg. I've been trained *Hic* not to give in to beggars.
...Aye. Aye, alright, alright... An angry witch is much worse than an angry *Hic* mayor. Take the key. Please tell her I gave it to you. Don't let her be angry.
You never saw me... I never shaw you. I was home, asleep, *Hic* dreaming of a job where folk stop asking me for keys. Or keys stop asking me for folk... Either one.
You again. Just... *Hic* take it before I re... reconshider.
I should go home... Tomorrow I'll have *Hic* regrets.
Wait. Who are you? My new guard, or my new favorite person?
Actually, do not answer. I am deciding you are my new favorite person.
Before I make my dramatic exit, anything you want to say?
You did it! You actually did it! I am out!
I know I can be a handful, but I promised to be useful, and I keep my promises.

choices.text: *Briefly explain your time-travel predicament to defeat Ardor.*
*Ask Ryiah to join you on your quest.* [BLUE](Join party)
*Tell her you don't need her help right now.*

14.name: Ryiah
text: You just broke a witch out of jail. Let's make it worth the trouble.
By the way, I have hidden a few of my belongings in a crate in front of the equipment shop. We should really go pick them up before we leave town.

20.name: Ryiah
text: Fine, but don't forget that I owe you one. If you ever need my help, just ask.

9000.name: Ryiah
text: I cannot repay my debt to you if I cannot join you. Make some room in your party and then talk to me again.
You're dismissing a witch. Bold move. I do hope you've thought about what you're giving up here.

choices.text: *Yes, you've thought about it. She can go.* [BLUE](Dismiss Ryiah)
*On reflection, no. Witches are useful.*

text: Fine. Don't come crying to me when things go sideways without magical backup.
All her equipment will also be gone once you bury her.

choices.text: *Yes, let the funeral continue.* [RED](Dismiss Ryiah)
*No, take precautions first.*

text: Oh, you came back. Ran into trouble without your witch, did you?

choices.text: *Yes. Without a witch, this party is just problems.* [BLUE](Join party)
*No, you just happened to walk past.*

text: Thought so. I still owe you one anyway. Let's go.
Sure you did. I'll be here when you're ready to stop lying to yourself.
I would love nothing more than to rejoin you. But even a witch can see there's no room. Come back when you've made space.
